notes: Verifies §5.3.3 协议层不变式 and §7.4 row 1: any upgrade lacking a verifiable human_witness MUST be refused. The ERROR envelope itself is signed by MS so the rejection is auditable on the Attestation Chain (Requirement 3.1).

post_state.note: Rejection does not mutate Mandate state; the Mandate remains at the pre-request grade. RP / IF wait for HP to re-issue with a valid human_witness (§EH.1 row '升级缺见证').

signature_verification.note: Real Ed25519 signatures over canonical CBOR. WebAuthn human_witness blobs are deterministic placeholders (see README); verifiers MUST treat their bytes as opaque and only validate structural presence.

summary: Negative: upgrade G3 → G2 without human_witness must be rejected with E_HUMAN_WITNESS_REQUIRED (1010).
